generations.en: Current generation: 9B dense / 35B-A3B MoE / 397B flagship, MIT licence; the README says the 35B-A3B "activates only ~3B parameters per token" (comparison claims are vendor-run wording).

licenses.en: MIT (model-card license_link points to the in-repo LICENSE)

claims.zh: 官方 README：「the mid-size mixture-of-experts member of the Ornith-1.5 family. It activates only ~3B parameters per token」；与 Qwen/Gemma/Muse 的横评数字为厂商自评基准，本站不背书。
claims.en: Official README: "the mid-size mixture-of-experts member of the Ornith-1.5 family. It activates only ~3B parameters per token"; the Qwen/Gemma/Muse comparison numbers are vendor-run benchmarks this site does not endorse.

positioning.zh: 新晋家族（2026 年才出现两代）：MIT 许可 + 三档尺寸覆盖单卡到旗舰。出品主体 DeepReinforce 的注册辖区官方未声明，本站按「国外出品」处理并在属地依据里写明（S52 口径）。
positioning.en: A newcomer (only two generations so far, both 2026): MIT licence plus three tiers from single-card to flagship. The publisher DeepReinforce's jurisdiction of registration is not officially stated; this site treats it as foreign-made and says so in the origin note (S52 convention).

onSite.zh: 本站已收录 Ornith 1.5 的量化对比（2 个模型仓）
onSite.en: This site covers Ornith 1.5 quantisations (2 model repos)
